solutions.title: Sweep line
solutions.strategy: Convert starts to +1 and ends to -1 events and track maximum active meetings.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Two events are stored for every interval.

solutions.title: Min-heap end times
solutions.strategy: Process intervals by start time and reuse the room whose end time is earliest when possible.

timeComplexity.explanation: Sorting plus heap operations over intervals dominate.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The heap can hold all active room end times.
